title: InvisibleGear
description: A lightweight resource pack that makes all armor invisible while keeping full protection and functionality. Perfect for players who want a cleaner look, better visibility, and an unobstructed view of their Minecraft skin.
body:
For a **Modrinth description**, you can use something like this:

# Invisible Gear
![FULL ASTHETIC , FULL PROTECTION](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/017851b5983ef98c693a8ce424f1f4902d343896.png)
![WITH TRIMS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/31c1d0f26f9a70834557e423ad7c285b831f1692.png)

Invisible Gear is a lightweight Minecraft resource pack that hides all armor textures while preserving their functionality. Enjoy a cleaner screen, better visibility, and a more immersive gameplay experience without sacrificing protection.

### Features

* All armor sets are fully invisible
* Works in Survival and Multiplayer
* No gameplay advantages or stat changes
* Lightweight and performance-friendly
* Compatible with Minecraft 1.21+

### Perfect For

* PvP players who prefer an unobstructed view
* Content creators and screenshot enthusiasts
* Players who enjoy seeing their skin without armor covering it
* Minimalist resource pack setups

### Notes

This pack only changes armor visuals. Armor durability, enchantments, protection values, and all other mechanics remain unchanged.

**See your skin. Keep your protection.**
